findings.what: Unauthenticated online booking matches patients on email alone and overwrites the existing patient's name/phone, altering PII shown on that patient's other appointments (and family members sharing an email collide).
DB unique index only covers exact start_time; overlapping off-grid override bookings rely on a READ COMMITTED app-level check that can race.
Rate limiter keyed on client-supplied x-forwarded-for (spoofable) and in-memory per instance.
No lower bound on reminderAt; a stalled cron sends reminders late, outside the 24h ±5 min window.
Custom schedule grid instead of the Schedule-X resource view named in PRD §8.1.
Calendar compares a browser-local date key with the clinic-timezone 'today'; off-by-one near midnight for users in other timezones.
Hard-coded fallback secrets whenever NODE_ENV != production; a misconfigured staging deploy accepts forgeable tokens.
